tools.name: docs
tools.description:
Google Docs operations.

Actions (required params -> optional):
- getText (documentId -> tabId, limit, preview)
- create (title -> content)
- writeText (documentId, text -> position, tabId)
- getSuggestions (documentId)
- replaceText (documentId, findText, replaceText -> tabId)
- formatText (documentId, formats -> tabId)

getText defaults to 20,000 characters, accepts limit 1-100,000, and marks truncated output explicitly. preview defaults to 2,000 characters unless limit is provided. getSuggestions is bounded separately: 20,000 characters and 100 suggestions by default (max_chars 1-100,000, full:true for every entry). These bounds limit response size without changing document authorization.

account = email of the Google account to use (default: primary).

account.description: Google account email to act as. Defaults to the primary account (config action="account_list").

position.description: Insert position for writeText: "beginning", "end" (default), or a positive integer index

tabId.description: Tab ID to target (optional, for multi-tab documents)

limit.description: Maximum Docs text characters for getText (1-100000; default 20000)

preview.description: Use a 2000-character getText preview unless limit is provided

max_chars.description: Maximum characters returned by getSuggestions (1-100000; default 20000)

full.description: Return every getSuggestions entry, bypassing the default 20000-character and 100-item bounds

findText.description: Text to find, must not be empty (for replaceText)

style.description: Heading level, text style, code font, or link (link needs url)

tools.name: time
tools.description:
Local date/time/timezone helpers (no Google account needed).

Actions:
- getCurrentDate
- getCurrentTime
- getTimeZone

account.description: Google account email to act as. Defaults to the primary account (config action="account_list").

tools.name: drive
tools.description:
Drive operations. See the action enum for operations available in this transport.

search, getComments and findFolder are bounded: 20,000 characters by default (max_chars 1-100,000, full:true for the complete payload). search and getComments page with pageSize and pageToken; findFolder caps at 50 name matches. Truncated output names its true size and how to fetch the rest. account = email of the Google account to use (default: primary).

account.description: Google account email to act as. Defaults to the primary account (config action="account_list").

pageSize.description: Maximum files or comments per page (for search, getComments; 1-100, default 20)

pageToken.description: Continuation token from a previous search page

unreadOnly.description: Restrict search to unread files where supported

sharedWithMe.description: Restrict search to files shared with the user

max_chars.description: Maximum characters returned by a bounded read action (1-100000; default 20000)

full.description: Return the complete payload, bypassing the default 20000-character and item bounds

localPath.description: Destination file for downloadFile, inside the server install directory; a relative path resolves against that directory. This action is available only over local stdio transport.

tools.name: calendar
tools.description:
Calendar operations. Actions: listCalendars, createEvent, listEvents, getEvent, deleteEvent, updateEvent, respondToEvent, findFreeTime.

listEvents, getEvent, listCalendars and findFreeTime are bounded: 20,000 characters by default (max_chars 1-100,000, full:true for the complete payload); listEvents pages with maxResults and pageToken and always returns its nextPageToken. Truncated output names its true size and how to fetch the rest. account = email of the Google account to use (default: primary).

account.description: Google account email to act as. Defaults to the primary account (config action="account_list").

dateTime.description: Start time of a timed event, e.g. 2026-03-01T09:00:00Z

date.description: Start day of an all-day event, YYYY-MM-DD

start.description: Event start, with exactly one of dateTime or date (for createEvent, updateEvent)

dateTime.description: End time of a timed event, e.g. 2026-03-01T10:00:00Z

date.description: Day after the last day of an all-day event, YYYY-MM-DD

end.description: Event end, with exactly one of dateTime or date (for createEvent, updateEvent)

attendees.description: Attendee emails (for createEvent, updateEvent), or the people whose shared free time findFreeTime looks for ("me" is the caller)

addGoogleMeet.description: Add a Google Meet link (for createEvent, updateEvent)

attachments.description: Drive files to attach; replaces any existing attachments (for createEvent, updateEvent)

eventType.description: Kind of event to create (for createEvent; default "default")

focusTimeProperties.description: Settings of a focusTime event (for createEvent)

outOfOfficeProperties.description: Settings of an outOfOffice event (for createEvent)

workingLocationProperties.description: Location of a workingLocation event (for createEvent)

timeMin.description: Window start (for listEvents, findFreeTime): YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss, optionally three fraction digits, then Z or a +HH:MM/-HH:MM offset, e.g. 2026-03-01T09:00:00Z or 2026-03-01T09:00:00.123+07:00. listEvents defaults to now; findFreeTime requires it.

timeMax.description: Window end (for listEvents, findFreeTime), in the same format as timeMin, e.g. 2026-03-01T09:00:00Z. listEvents defaults to 30 days from now; findFreeTime requires it.

eventTypes.description: Return only events of these kinds (for listEvents)

attendeeResponseStatus.description: Keep events where the caller answered with one of these (for listEvents; default accepted, tentative, needsAction)

sendNotification.description: Send update emails about the answer (for respondToEvent; default true)

responseMessage.description: Comment attached to the answer (for respondToEvent)

duration.description: Length of the free slot to find, in minutes (for findFreeTime)

maxResults.description: Maximum events per page (for listEvents; 1-100, default 20)

pageToken.description: Continuation token from a previous listEvents page

max_chars.description: Maximum characters returned by a bounded read action (1-100000; default 20000)

full.description: Return the complete payload, bypassing the default 20000-character and item bounds

tools.name: chat
tools.description:
Chat operations. Actions: listSpaces, sendMessage, findSpaceByName, getMessages, sendDm, findDmByEmail, listThreads, setUpSpace.

listSpaces, getMessages, listThreads and findSpaceByName are bounded: 20,000 characters by default (max_chars 1-100,000, full:true for the complete payload). All three listings page with pageSize and pageToken and always return their nextPageToken; findSpaceByName caps at 50 matches. account = email of the Google account to use (default: primary).

account.description: Google account email to act as. Defaults to the primary account (config action="account_list").

spaceName.description: Space resource name, e.g. spaces/AAAA (for sendMessage, getMessages, listThreads)

email.description: Email of the other person (for sendDm, findDmByEmail)

threadName.description: Thread resource name, e.g. spaces/AAAA/threads/BBBB: the thread to reply in (sendMessage, sendDm) or to read (getMessages)

userNames.description: Members of the new space, as users/<user ID or email> (for setUpSpace)

pageSize.description: Maximum spaces, messages, or threads per page (for listSpaces, getMessages, listThreads; 1-100, default 20)

pageToken.description: Continuation token from a previous page

max_chars.description: Maximum characters returned by a bounded read action (1-100000; default 20000)

full.description: Return the complete payload, bypassing the default 20000-character and item bounds

orderBy.description: Message ordering expression, e.g. "createTime desc" (for getMessages)

tools.name: gmail
tools.description:
Gmail operations. Actions: search, get, modify, batchModify, modifyThread, send, createDraft, sendDraft, listLabels, createLabel.

get, modify, modifyThread, search and listLabels are bounded: 20,000 characters by default (max_chars 1-100,000, full:true for the complete payload), so a long message body is cut with an explicit marker instead of flooding the response. search pages with maxResults and pageToken. account = email of the Google account to use (default: primary).

Local stdio transport only: downloadAttachment saves an attachment to an absolute localPath on this machine, and createDraft attaches local files through attachments.

account.description: Google account email to act as. Defaults to the primary account (config action="account_list").

threadId.description: Thread to change (for modifyThread) or to add the draft to (for createDraft)

localPath.description: Absolute local file path to save the attachment to (for downloadAttachment). This action is available only over local stdio transport.

to.description: Recipient email address, or an array of addresses

cc.description: Cc email address, or an array of addresses

bcc.description: Bcc email address, or an array of addresses

isHtml.description: Treat body as HTML instead of plain text (default false)

filePath.description: Absolute local filesystem path to the file to attach (e.g., "/Users/name/downloads/report.pdf"). Use the downloadAttachment action first to save an email attachment locally before referencing it here.

filename.description: Display name for the attachment in the email. Defaults to the filename portion of filePath.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the attachment (e.g., "application/pdf"). Inferred from the file extension when omitted; falls back to "application/octet-stream".

attachments.description: Local files to attach (for createDraft). Attachments are read from the server filesystem, so they are available only over local stdio transport.

labelIds.description: Restrict search to these label IDs

addLabelIds.description: Label IDs to add (for modify, batchModify, modifyThread)

removeLabelIds.description: Label IDs to remove (for modify, batchModify, modifyThread)

labelListVisibility.description: Label visibility in the label list (for createLabel; default labelShow)

messageListVisibility.description: Label visibility in the message list (for createLabel; default show)

maxResults.description: Maximum messages per page (for search; 1-100, default 20)

pageToken.description: Continuation token from a previous search page

includeSpamTrash.description: Include spam and trash in search results

max_chars.description: Maximum characters returned by a bounded read action (1-100000; default 20000)

full.description: Return the complete payload, bypassing the default 20000-character and item bounds

format.description: Message payload detail (for get; default full)

tools.name: slides
tools.description:
Slides operations. Actions: getText, getMetadata, create, addSlide, deleteSlide, duplicateSlide, reorderSlides, getSpeakerNotes, updateSpeakerNotes, replaceAllText, insertText, deleteText, addShape, addImage, addTable, updateTextStyle, updateShapeProperties.

getText, getMetadata and getSpeakerNotes are bounded: 20,000 characters by default (max_chars 1-100,000, full:true for the complete payload) and at most 100 slide entries. Truncated output names its true size and how to fetch the rest. Positions and sizes are in points (PT). account = email of the Google account to use (default: primary).

Local stdio transport only: getImages saves every image as a PNG in the localPath directory and is bounded like the reads above, at most 100 image entries; getSlideThumbnail saves the slide thumbnail PNG to the localPath file and returns its URL, size and saved path, never cut. localPath must be absolute.

account.description: Google account email to act as. Defaults to the primary account (config action="account_list").

presentationId.description: Presentation ID or URL (all actions except create)

max_chars.description: Maximum characters returned by a bounded read action (1-100000; default 20000)

full.description: Return the complete payload, bypassing the default 20000-character and item bounds

localPath.description: Absolute local directory to save every image to (for getImages), or absolute local file path to save the thumbnail to (for getSlideThumbnail). These actions are available only over local stdio transport.

slideObjectId.description: Slide object ID (for deleteSlide, duplicateSlide, updateSpeakerNotes, addShape, addImage, addTable, getSlideThumbnail)

slideObjectIds.description: Slide object IDs to move, listed in their current deck order (for reorderSlides)

objectId.description: Object ID of the shape or text box to edit (for insertText, deleteText, updateTextStyle, updateShapeProperties), or an optional ID for the new slide or element (for addSlide, addShape, addImage, addTable)

insertionIndex.description: Zero-based position: where the new slide goes (for addSlide; default end), where the moved slides go (for reorderSlides), or the character index to insert at (for insertText; default 0)

layoutId.description: Layout object ID of the new slide (for addSlide)

predefinedLayout.description: Predefined layout of the new slide (for addSlide)

findText.description: Text to find in every slide (for replaceAllText)

matchCase.description: Match case when finding text (for replaceAllText; default true)

range.description: Text range (for deleteText, updateTextStyle; default {"type": "ALL"}). FIXED_RANGE needs startIndex and endIndex; FROM_START_INDEX needs startIndex.

shapeType.description: Slides API shape type, e.g. TEXT_BOX or RECTANGLE (for addShape)

x.description: Left offset in points (for addShape, addImage, addTable)

y.description: Top offset in points (for addShape, addImage, addTable)

width.description: Width in points (for addShape, addImage, addTable)

height.description: Height in points (for addShape, addImage, addTable)

style.description: Slides API TextStyle as a JSON object string, e.g. {"bold": true} (for updateTextStyle)

shapeProperties.description: Slides API ShapeProperties as a JSON object string (for updateShapeProperties)

fields.description: Field mask of the properties to change, e.g. "bold" (for updateTextStyle, updateShapeProperties)

tools.name: sheets
tools.description:
Sheets operations. Actions: getText, getRange, getMetadata.

getText and getRange return at most 20,000 characters by default (max_chars 1-100,000) and mark truncated output explicitly with the true size and omitted count; pass full:true for the complete payload. account = email of the Google account to use (default: primary).

account.description: Google account email to act as. Defaults to the primary account (config action="account_list").

max_chars.description: Maximum characters returned by getText/getRange (1-100000; default 20000)

full.description: Return the complete getText/getRange payload, bypassing the default 20000-character bound

tools.name: tasks
tools.description:
Tasks operations. Actions: listTaskLists, listTasks, createTask, updateTask, completeTask, deleteTask.

listTasks and listTaskLists are bounded: 20,000 characters by default (max_chars 1-100,000, full:true for the complete payload) and page with maxResults and pageToken. Truncated output names its true size and how to fetch the rest. account = email of the Google account to use (default: primary).

account.description: Google account email to act as. Defaults to the primary account (config action="account_list").

due.description: Due date as an RFC3339 timestamp (for createTask, updateTask); Google Tasks keeps only the date

showAssigned.description: Include tasks assigned to the caller (for listTasks)

dueMin.description: Earliest due date, RFC3339 timestamp (for listTasks)

dueMax.description: Latest due date, RFC3339 timestamp (for listTasks)

max_chars.description: Maximum characters returned by a bounded read action (1-100000; default 20000)

full.description: Return the complete payload, bypassing the default 20000-character and item bounds

maxResults.description: Maximum task lists or tasks per page (for listTaskLists, listTasks; 1-100, default 20)

pageToken.description: Continuation token from a previous page

tools.name: people
tools.description:
People operations. Actions: getUserProfile, getMe, getUserRelations.

All three actions are bounded: 20,000 characters by default (max_chars 1-100,000, full:true for the complete payload), and getUserRelations keeps at most 50 relations. Truncated output names its true size and how to fetch the rest. account = email of the Google account to use (default: primary).

account.description: Google account email to act as. Defaults to the primary account (config action="account_list").

max_chars.description: Maximum characters returned by a bounded read action (1-100000; default 20000)

full.description: Return the complete payload, bypassing the default 20000-character and item bounds

userId.description: Person ID, with or without the people/ prefix (for getUserProfile; for getUserRelations, defaults to the caller)

email.description: Email to look up in the directory (for getUserProfile)

name.description: Name to look up in the directory (for getUserProfile)

relationType.description: Keep only relations of this type, e.g. manager or spouse (for getUserRelations)

tools.name: forms
tools.description:
Google Forms operations.

Actions (required params -> optional):
- create (title -> documentTitle)
- get (formId)
- batchUpdate (formId, requests)
- listResponses (formId -> pageSize, pageToken, filter)
- getResponse (formId, responseId)

Questions are added with batchUpdate, not create. Responses are read-only (the Forms API cannot write one), and listing or deleting forms goes through the drive tool.

get, getResponse and listResponses are bounded: 20,000 characters by default (max_chars 1-100,000, full:true for the complete payload); listResponses pages with pageSize and pageToken.

account = email of the Google account to use (default: primary).

account.description: Google account email to act as. Defaults to the primary account (config action="account_list").

formId.description: Form ID, or the editor URL https://docs.google.com/forms/d/<formId>/edit

title.description: Form title shown to respondents (for create)

documentTitle.description: Drive file name, when it should differ from the title (for create)

requests.description: Forms API batchUpdate requests, e.g. [{"createItem": {...}}] (for batchUpdate)

pageSize.description: Maximum responses per page (for listResponses; 1-100, default 20)

pageToken.description: Page token from a previous listResponses call

max_chars.description: Maximum characters returned by a bounded read action (1-100000; default 20000)

full.description: Return the complete payload, bypassing the default 20000-character and item bounds

tools.name: config
tools.description:
Manage server configuration, credential state, and the Google accounts this server can act as.

Actions:
- status: current credential state plus the configured accounts and which is primary
- setup_start: instructions to configure the Google account via browser OAuth (HTTP: run `workspace auth --user <namespace>` on the host)
- setup_reset: clear credentials, return to awaiting_setup
- setup_complete: re-check credentials after external config changes
- set: update a runtime setting (M1 has no mutable settings; returns info)
- cache_clear: clear any cached state (no-op in M1)
- account_add: start the browser consent flow for one more account (stdio: returns a URL to open; HTTP: returns the `workspace auth --user <namespace>` command to run on the host)
- account_list: list configured accounts and the primary one
- account_remove (account): forget one account; a remaining account is promoted if it was primary
- account_set_default (account): make one account the primary (used when a call omits account)

tools.name: help
tools.description: Get full documentation for a topic. Use when compressed tool descriptions are insufficient.
